text.body: ॥ rāvaṇakṛtaśivatāṇḍavastotram ॥ jaṭākaṭāhasambhramabhramannillimpanirjharīvilolavīcivallarīvirājamānamūrdhani । dhagaddhagaddhagajjvalallalāṭapaṭṭapāvake kiśoracandraśekhare ratiḥ pratikṣaṇaṃ mama ॥ dharādharendranandinīvilāsabandhubandhurasphuradigantasantatipramodamānamānase । kṛpākaṭākṣadhoraṇīniruddhadurdharāpadi kaciccidambare mano vinodametu vastuni ॥ jaṭābhujaṅgapiṅgalasphuratphaṇāmaṇiprabhākadambakuṅkumadravapraliptadigvadhūmukhe । madāndhasindhurasphurattvaguttarīyamedure mano vinodamadbhutaṃ bibhartuṃ bhūtabhartari ॥ sahasralocanaprabhṛtyaśeṣalekhaśekharaprasūnadhūlidhoraṇīvidhūsarāṅghripīṭhabhūḥ । bhujaṅgarājamālayā nibaddhajāṭajūṭakaḥ śriyai cirāya jāyatāṃ cakorabandhuśekharaḥ ॥ 4 lalāṭacatvarajvaladdhanañjayasphuliṅgabhānipītapañcasrāyakaṃ namannilimpanāyakam । sudhāmayūkhalekhayā virājamānaśekharaṃ mahākapālisampade śiro jaṭālamastu naḥ॥ 5 karālabhālapaṭṭikādhagaddhagaddhagajjvaladdhanañjayādharīkṛtapracaṇḍapañcasāyake । dharādharendranandinīkucāgracitrapatrakaprakalpanaikaśilpini trilocane matirmama ॥ 6 navīnameghamaṇḍalīniruddhadurdharasphuratkuhūniśīthinītamaḥprabandhabandhukandharaḥ। nilimpanirjharīdharastanotu kṛtisindhuraḥ kalānidhānabandhuraḥ śriyaṃ jagadhdurandharaḥ ॥7 praphullanīlapaṅkajaprapañcakālimacchaṭāviḍambikaṇṭhakandharāruciprabandha kandharam । smaracchidaṃ puracchidaṃ bhavacchidaṃ makhacchidaṃ gajacchidāndhakacchidaṃ tamantakacchidaṃ bhaje ॥ agarvasarvamaṅgalākalākadambamañjarīrasapravāhamādhurīvijṛmbhaṇāmadhuvratam । smarāntakaṃ purāntakaṃ bhavāntakaṃ makhāntakaṃ gajāntakāndhakāntakaṃ tamantakāntakaṃ bhaje ॥ jayatvadhabhravibhramabhramadbhujaṅgamasphuraddhagaddhagadvinirgamatkarālaphālahavyavāṭ । dhimiddhimiddhimidhvananmṛdaṅgatuṅgamaṅgaladhvanikramapravartitapracaṇḍatāṇḍavaḥ śivaḥ ॥ dṛṣadvicitratalpayorbhujaṅgamauktikasrajorgariṣṭharatnaloṣṭhayoḥ suhṛdvipakṣapakṣayoḥ। tṛṇāravindacakṣuṣoḥ prajāmahīmahendrayoḥ samaṃ pravartayanmanaḥ kadā sadāśivaṃ bhaje ॥ kadā nilimpanirjharīnikuñjakoṭare vasanvimuktadurmatiḥ sadā śiraḥsthamañjaliṃ vahan । rāvaṇakṛtaśivatāṇḍavastotram vimuktalolalocanālalāmaphālalagnakaḥ śiveti mantramuccarankadā sukhī bhavāmyaham ॥ 12 imaṃ hi nityamevamuktamuttamottamaṃ stavaṃ paṭhansmaranbruvannaro viśuddhimeti santatam । hare gurau sa bhaktimāśu yāti nānyathā gatiṃ vimohanaṃ hi dehināṃ tu śaṅkarasya cintanam ॥ 13 pūjāvasānasamaye daśavakragītaṃ yaḥ śambhupūjanamidaṃ paṭhati pradoṣe । tasya sthirāṃ rathagajendraturaṅgayuktāṃ lakṣmīṃ sadaiva sumukhīṃ pradadāti śambhuḥ ॥ 14 ॥ iti śrīrāvaṇaviracitaṃ śivatāṇḍavastotraṃ sampūrṇam ॥
